proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6141 dadāti gives Prakrit deī and Old Awadhi dei gives plus Nepali dinu and regional de- imperatives. Chitwan dei is compared with this give stem; the source combines imperative/past elicitation labels, so no unique tense is asserted. Exact survey form dei is preserved.
